## INFO SECTIONS

additionalInfoClimate:
Barcelona in June is warm and sunny, 24–28°C during the day. Pack light summer clothes, sunscreen and a light layer for evenings. No rain expected — perfect beach and terrace weather.

additionalInfoDressCode:
Smart casual for most restaurants. For your fine dining reservation at ABaC bring elegant attire — no shorts or flip flops. Beach clubs welcome swimwear during the day. Comfortable walking shoes recommended for the Gothic Quarter.

additionalInfoUsefulTips:
Currency is Euro. Tipping ~10% in restaurants is appreciated but not mandatory. Uber and taxis are widely available. Emergency number: 112. The Gothic Quarter is best explored on foot — wear comfortable shoes. Most restaurants open for dinner from 21:00. Your hotel concierge speaks English.
